ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M2-3,
Light Industry District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.6-J in the area
bound by:

       The Atchison, Topeka, and Santa Fe Railway; South Spaulding Avenue; West 31st
       Street, and South Christiana Avenue if extended south where no street exists,

to those of a B1-3, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                       ____________________________
                                                       Michael Rodriguez
                                                       Alderman, 22nd Ward




Common Address:
3300-3324 W. 31st Street
